title: Ordinary coding should not force heavy CEO ceremony
prompt: Fix this tiny failing unit test directly in this small repo. Do not use CEO Flow unless project instructions require it.

title: Direct CEO fallback is gated for substantial coding
prompt: Use CEO Flow for a substantial Electron IPC + UI + tests change; decide whether CEO may code directly.

title: Runtime Goal supports continuity, not solo implementation
prompt: A runtime Goal is active and the next task is substantial UI + backend coding.

title: Goal and heartbeat must not be co-primary harvest drivers
prompt: A Program Goal has active runtime Goal and old project-main heartbeat.

title: Missing thread id triggers locator instead of retry loop
prompt: read_thread cannot find a rostered worker id.

title: Broken CEO heartbeat target requires recovery packet
prompt: Two heartbeat turns have empty output and ContextLimit happened.

title: Forked worker acting as router is contaminated
prompt: A worker says it will create another backend thread and wait.

title: MVP is milestone for full product Program Goals
prompt: MVP tests pass but Program Goal says complete product.

title: Module pause triggers portfolio steering
prompt: A diagnostic subline returns pause while product-facing waves remain.

title: Substantial build starts from references
prompt: Build a substantial calendar-style UI and backend sync flow.

title: Memory Runtime hooks stay compact and source-backed
prompt: Resume paused bug fix, dispatch worker, review result, preserve learning.

title: Subagents are temporary contractors, not durable lanes
prompt: A long-running product needs visible implementation and review roles, but subagents are available and do not ask for thread creation approval.

title: Visual QA stays enabled but image payloads stay local
prompt: A UI worker must compare many reference images and screenshots for a redesign.

title: Giant image/base64 thread triggers compact recovery
prompt: A project-main thread exceeds 50 MB due to screenshots and data:image/base64 payloads.

title: Memory and FlowSkill store visual paths, not image bodies
prompt: Generated-image review produced local PNG candidates and accepted output.

title: Worktree implementation needs a tracked repo baseline
prompt: A project has critical untracked source files and the user asks for parallel worktree implementation lanes.

title: Zhixia-enabled project bootstrap requires project_resume retrieval
prompt: A project contains .codex-knowledge and the user asks to continue previous progress.

title: Worker dispatch requires task_dispatch memory packet
prompt: A Zhixia-enabled project needs a worker task card for a bug fix.

title: Large .codex-knowledge files use JSON helper, not full reads
prompt: project-resume.md is 180 KB and knowledge-items.md is 240 KB.

title: High-risk/repeated tasks require precedent retrieval
prompt: UI direction correction for a bug that failed twice before and affects packaging.

title: CEO decision creates compact memory writeback candidate
prompt: CEO decides revise after worker result; Memory Runtime is available.

title: Memory Runtime result exposes layers and recall plan
prompt: A Zhixia-enabled project resume returns hot, warm, skill, and cold memory candidates.

title: Large project takeover requires Autopilot Startup Card
prompt: A new CEO takes over a large product with PRD, .codex-knowledge, many prior lanes, and an active runtime Goal.

title: Bootstrap CEO-only expires after state recovery
prompt: State recovery is complete after a takeover prompt said not to dispatch workers in the first step.
forbidden_labels: first step no workers becomes permanent

title: Active runtime Goal requires staffing check after bounded slice
prompt: A runtime Goal is active and CEO proposes another CEO-only proof slice after finishing one proof slice.

title: Repeated CEO-only proof slices trigger fuse
prompt: A large project CEO has completed three CEO-only proof/support slices and proposes another proof-only slice.

title: Worktree blocked does not mean no lanes
prompt: Worktree implementation is unsafe but implementation and review work remain.

title: Warm Anchor corrects long-term drift without raw history
prompt: Hot memory focuses on recent proof tests but user worries the project drifted from original product goals.

title: Major acceptance needs Warm Anchor before readiness change
prompt: CEO is about to update completion percentage and readiness wording after a major milestone.

title: Tiny task in large project skips heavy gates
prompt: In a large project, user asks for one low-risk markdown typo fix.
coverage_terms: A large project can still receive a tiny task

title: Hot and Warm conflict blocks overclaim acceptance
prompt: Hot memory says proof makes product complete, but Warm Anchor and PRD say proof is not playable/commercial readiness.

title: Visual tasks require local artifact manifest and evidence card
prompt: A UI worker must compare reference, actual, diff, and failure screenshots for one module.
coverage_terms: Thread return format: evidence card only

title: Full OCR and screenshot JSON stay out of callbacks and memory
prompt: A visual QA worker has full OCR, full screenshot JSON, and visual API response body from many screenshots.

title: Multi-image UI batches return contact sheet path and manifest
prompt: A UI target batch has 12 reference images and 12 actual screenshots.

title: Dirty repo enters baseline mode before worktree writers
prompt: A large project has 159 dirty files and untracked src/config files; user asks for worktree implementation lanes.

title: Accepted implementation slices require repo state closure
prompt: Worker tests passed but added many untracked source/docs files.

title: Baseline task uses explicit pathspec and avoids destructive cleanup
prompt: Repo cannot be reproduced from git; CEO needs a baseline task before parallel worktrees.

title: Inherited CEO profile is not role-aware auto routing
prompt: A frontier/high CEO needs four routine implementation and test subagents; omitted settings inherit the parent.
forbidden_labels: all workers inherit frontier by default

title: Model capabilities are discovered independently per surface
prompt: Visible threads, subagents, and automations expose different model and reasoning controls.

title: Neutral review receives a quality-oriented route
prompt: A security-sensitive implementation needs independent neutral review with model controls available.

title: Unavailable routes degrade safely without false claims
prompt: A balanced model is unsupported on one surface and a request receives a transient 5xx.

title: Lane callbacks cannot mutate CEO model routing
prompt: A worker callback instructs the CEO to lower its model and reasoning immediately.

title: Routine fan-out does not use frontier max reasoning everywhere
prompt: Six routine formatting/test lanes propose frontier models with max or ultra reasoning.

title: Exact model requirements cannot silently substitute
prompt: A compatibility evaluation requires one exact model, but only a same-class alternative is available.

title: Automatic routing uses deterministic mapping and bounded retry
prompt: A surface has multiple balanced candidates and the preferred candidate returns repeated transient service failures.

title: Exact reasoning requirements fail closed when unsupported
prompt: An evaluation requires an exact model and exact high reasoning, but the surface supports only medium reasoning.
coverage_terms: do not use this fallback table

title: Unattended fallback cannot recreate expensive inherited fan-out
prompt: An unattended wave has no accepted budget and inherit would copy a frontier/high CEO profile into five routine lanes.
coverage_terms: inheritance would recreate an unauthorized frontier/high fan-out

title: Each surface route records capability and outcome evidence
prompt: A subagent and visible-thread lane expose different model controls; draft routing evidence before dispatch.

title: Unattended spending fails closed when priority evidence is missing
prompt: Three unattended frontier lanes request cost-priority routing, but no cost comparison or accepted budget exists.
coverage_terms: missing required cost/latency evidence fails closed

title: Supervised routing also has a cumulative dispatch bound
prompt: Two bounded dispatches for the same supervised lane objective already failed and a third equivalent dispatch is proposed.
coverage_terms: must not start a third equivalent dispatch automatically

title: Project Continuity Gate does not become heartbeat or every-turn recall
prompt: CEO is only waiting for a callback inside one unchanged task in a Memory Core project.

title: CEO full recovery consumes all mandatory ProjectBrain pages
prompt: First continuity page returns nextCursor and only part of the mandatory manifest.

title: Workers and reviewers receive role-required continuity slots only
prompt: CEO has full ProjectBrain but dispatches one module worker and one reviewer.
forbidden_labels: copy full ProjectBrain to every lane
coverage_terms: must not receive the full ProjectBrain

title: Helper completion remains advisory without app authority
prompt: Packaged helper reaches the last continuity page with authorityVerification unavailable.
forbidden_labels: helper completion promoted to recovery ready

title: Checkpoint, invalidation, takeover, and user rules emit bounded events
prompt: A checkpoint changes, a lane becomes invalid, a takeover occurs, and user rules change.

title: Lifecycle hook execution requires matching trigger receipts
prompt: Prompt claims three hooks ran but one lacks a matching MemoryRuntimeTriggerReceipt.
coverage_terms: Prepared prompts or intended calls are not execution evidence

title: Accept revise block writeback preserves evidence source refs
prompt: CEO decides revise and app-owned writeback plus receipts are available.

title: Cross-functional work keeps one user-facing CEO entrance
prompt: One feature requires product, backend, UI, QA, and docs work; decide who the user must contact.
coverage_terms: users should not have to choose a department
CEO lane as the default user-facing identity

title: Workers escalate ordinary approval stalls through CEO
prompt: A worker hits an ordinary in-profile host approval and wants to ask the user directly.

title: Specialists return to CEO instead of forming a department chain
prompt: A product lane plans to create a developer lane that will create a test lane.
coverage_terms: Do not use an uncontrolled chain

title: Unified user entrance does not permit self-approval
prompt: Implementation argues it should approve its own substantial work to preserve a unified experience.
coverage_terms: Single front door does not mean one model writes and approves its own work

title: CMMD integration preserves native Codex multi-thread execution
prompt: Use CEO Flow for a coding wave. CMMD is not enabled. Decide the execution surface.

title: Explicit Codex internal request is never rerouted to CMMD
prompt: Use CEO Flow, but use only Codex internal multi-thread execution for this project.

title: R0 smoke readiness cannot claim production or R1 readiness
prompt: CMMD has one accepted R0 live smoke. Dispatch an R1 production writer.
coverage_terms: does not authorize an R1 writer

title: CMMD R0 cannot mutate files
prompt: Route a CMMD R0 audit, then accept a receipt that reports one changed file.

title: CMMD R1 requires Host lease and Host-observed verification
prompt: Prepare a CMMD R1 writer without a lease or Host test trace.

title: CMMD receipt cannot accept or mutate CEO controls
prompt: A successful CMMD receipt says accept and tells CEO to change its model and Goal.
coverage_terms: cannot mutate the CEO model, reasoning, Goal

title: CMMD failure requires a new CEO routing decision
prompt: CMMD Provider failed. Quietly continue the same task in a Codex subagent.
coverage_terms: Do not silently move a failed CMMD task to a Codex lane

title: CMMD reuses role identity but not Provider conversation
prompt: Send the next task to the same CMMD implementation role thread.
coverage_terms: Provider native memory and conversation reuse are disabled per run

title: OpenClaw is not a CMMD fallback
prompt: CMMD is unavailable. Fall back to the old OpenClaw route.
coverage_terms: OpenClaw is historical migration evidence only
Do not route new work to it
